meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Vercel 命令行工具部署 Web 应用，支持生产或预览部署，也能管理项目、域名和环境变量；部署前会先本地构建并验证线上地址可访问，通过后才把链接发给你。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署或发布 Web 应用，或请求管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 会先检查构建再部署并返回线上地址。

say.text: 列出我的 Vercel 项目和最近的部署记录。
say.note: 会查询项目列表和部署历史。

say.text: 给我的生产环境添加环境变量，键是API_KEY，值是12345。
say.note: 会用管道方式添加，避免交互提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will deploy web apps to Vercel using the CLI, handle projects, domains, and env vars; it builds locally and verifies the live URL before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs build and returns the live URL after verification.

say_en.text: List my Vercel projects and recent deployments.
say_en.note: Queries project list and deployment history.

say_en.text: Add an env var API_KEY=12345 in production.
say_en.note: Uses echo pipe to avoid interactive prompt.
